headline.note: e_s is controlled by the through-flow past the bottleneck, which is identical for model and classical: the DM-G cap omega_max = (Q_xi - u_xi sigma_xi)_+ with sigma_xi = beta w P/(v_f + w) = 24.26 veh/km (beta = 0.5) decays linearly in u_xi, while the SUMO through-flow at X_q is ~2.0e3 veh/h at every speed (wake_flow_Xq_vehh below); at u_xi = 20 m/s the emitted wake state omega_max (1 + u/(v_f - u)) = 891 veh/h matches the simulated flow, hence e_s ~ -29% for both models

headline.verdict: model exceeds classical W1 by 32% at u=10
headline.note: the classical model's through-flow past the bottleneck is set by the DM-G cap omega_max = (Q_xi - u_xi sigma_xi)_+ with sigma_xi = beta w P/(v_f + w) = 24.26 veh/km (beta = 0.5), which decays linearly in u_xi (omega_max_classical_vehh below), whereas the SUMO through-flow at X_q stays at 1924-2085 veh/h at every speed; catch & release without the cap has no such bound -- its through-flow is set by the s-impermeable interface plus capture (2077-2326 veh/h over the sweep vs 845-1791 veh/h for the classical model)
